claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM for 5 days, this IL1B/TNF-directed interleukin inhibitor is unlikely to kill cells directly; any observed killing would most plausibly reflect weak, non-selective cytotoxicity or a cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress effect rather than pathway-specific IL-1/TNF blockade.
